articles.title: G&A Partners Acquires New York-Based CPEO Firm Ethan Allen HR Services, Expanding PEO and HR Outsourcing Capabilities in the Northeast
articles.mainIdea: G&A Partners Acquires New York-Based CPEO Firm Ethan Allen HR Services, Expanding PEO and HR Outsourcing Capabilities in the Northeast
articles.summary: Business Wire: G&A Partners Acquires New York-Based CPEO Firm Ethan Allen HR Services, Expanding PEO and HR Outsourcing Capabilities in the Northeast. HOUSTON, January 13, 2026--G&A Partners, a leading professional employer organization (PEO) and human resources outsourcing provider, announced today its acquisition of Ethan Allen HR Services, an Ethan Allen WorkForce Solutions company and prominent IRS-Certified Professional Employer Organization (CPEO) provider based in Poughkeepsie, New York.
